# User Stories

## Ordering

### US1.1 Choose a pickup slot
As a returning customer, I want to choose a pickup slot, so that I can collect my bread while it is fresh.

- FR1 (traces to)

- AC1.1.1 Given a slot with capacity, when I select it, then it is reserved for 10 minutes.
- AC1.1.2 Given a full slot, when I view slots, then it is shown as unavailable.

### US1.2 Menu
Customers can see the menu.

### US1.3 Tomorrow's orders
As a bakery owner, I want to see tomorrow's orders, so that I can plan the baking schedule.

Acceptance criteria:
- The list shows every order due tomorrow.
- Orders are grouped by pickup slot.

### US1.4 Dark mode
I want a dark mode.
